items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation
items.claim: Moses is commanded to instruct the Israelites regarding vow practices and valuation

items.quote: When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation
items.claim: A man making a vow dedicates persons to the LORD per a valuation
